purpose: Predict 1/X/2 directly; exact-score loss is not a selection criterion
dataStatus: All available seasons have been inspected in earlier research. This is retrospective nested walk-forward evaluation, not a new independent holdout.
features: Prequential Poisson probabilities, Elo and opponent-adjusted recent/venue residuals; no target results or future data
selection: Minimum 1X2 log loss on preceding season, including unchanged baseline as candidate; then refit selected family on all preceding seasons
fitting: Standardization on training only; regularized multinomial logit correction around baseline log probabilities; coefficients bounded to +/-1.5
presentation: At most three outright favorites per Lisbon day, sorted by probability with p>=0.5; no forced quota
promotion: Nested pooled 1X2 log loss improvement with paired ISO-week bootstrap lower 95% bound >0, Brier no worse, and top-three daily hit rate no worse; improvement must have same sign in both outer folds. Otherwise record research and preserve active model.
restrictions: No retuning after observing outer-fold output; no ROI without historical odds; no claim of certainty. Prospective confirmation remains necessary.
